settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Block a vendor when it is down or costs too much. For lookups the agent moves to the next vendor for that channel (email: apollo, aiark, treg (pdl + hunter), pdl, hunter; phone: aiark, pdl). Mailbox, LinkedIn and channel switches stop sends; unipile also stops LinkedIn search in the chat. hubspot holds new campaign steps for users who connected HubSpot.
settings.subtitle: System switches. They apply to every user within 30 seconds, without a deploy.
settings.addHint: Format: vendor_disabled:NAME or channel_disabled:NAME. A new switch starts off.
settings.invalidKey: The key must be vendor_disabled: or channel_disabled: followed by the vendor or channel name
settings.exists: Already exists: use its switch in the list

confirmOnBody.lookup: It applies in production to every user within 30 seconds: the agent stops calling this vendor and uses another one for the same search when there is one.
confirmOnBody.mailbox: It applies in production to every user within 30 seconds: queued campaign emails from this provider’s mailboxes wait, and answers from the Inbox and test emails sent from them are refused with a 503 error. Mailboxes of the other provider keep sending.
confirmOnBody.email: It applies in production to every user within 30 seconds: queued campaign emails wait, and answers from the Inbox and test emails are refused with a 503 error.
confirmOnBody.linkedin: It applies in production to every user within 30 seconds: queued LinkedIn campaign steps wait, and answers from the Inbox are refused with a 503 error.
confirmOnBody.unipile: It applies in production to every user within 30 seconds: queued LinkedIn campaign steps wait, answers from the Inbox are refused with a 503 error, and LinkedIn search in the chat stops.
confirmOnBody.crm: It applies in production to every user within 30 seconds: for users who connected HubSpot, new campaign steps to people with an email wait, because nobody passes without the HubSpot check, and write-back to HubSpot waits. Steps already queued still send, except HubSpot task steps, which wait too.
confirmOnBody.instantly: It applies in production to every user within 30 seconds: connecting Instantly, listing its campaigns, previews, new batches and a Retry are refused with a 503 error. A batch that is sending stops before its next chunk and ends as failed: its people stay waiting and a Retry resumes them once the switch is off. Cancel still works, and people already added stay in Instantly.
confirmOnBody.other: It applies in production to every user within 30 seconds: the system stops using this vendor or channel.

settings.confirmOffBody: It applies in production to every user within 30 seconds: the vendor or channel is available again.
